title: populus nigra subsp. italica
intro: Populus nigra subsp. italica, commonly known as Italian black poplar, is a subspecies of the black poplar tree that is native to Europe and the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Italian black poplar include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, making it a useful natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
